Reuse canonical APIs without backend/schema or permission changes. 64 focused checks and actual disposable PostgreSQL browser start/end/revoke, stale recovery and synthetic assignment/acknowledgement/pickup pass. First browser probe correctly hit acknowledgement guard; final scenario acknowledges before pickup. Release pending.
Final browser acceptance also holds the mutation response and verifies Escape cannot close an in-flight update. Web production build and TypeScript passed.

Scope clarification required by the user’s intended web-only completion: current web Orders still requires mobile pickup/proof. Add stable DWT-05 for canonical web delivery actions/proof/handover. Trip-only fafc162 candidate will not be promoted; retain all earlier requirements/gates/holds.

DWT-05 verified by actual UI acknowledgement/pickup/departure/arrival, real consented multipart photo, missing-proof rejection, customer-code full handover and trip end.
